name: unreadable-structure
description: The file structure cannot be read as Lore elements.

name: top-level-text
description: Text appears at the top level outside any element.

name: unknown-element
description: An element name is not part of the format.

name: duplicate-file-block
description: A file contains more than one file block.

name: file-block-after-entry
description: A file block appears after the first entry.

name: invalid-yaml
description: A block body is not valid YAML.

name: duplicate-key
description: A mapping repeats the same key.

name: yaml-feature-not-allowed
description: A block uses a YAML feature outside the allowed subset.

name: invalid-defaults
description: A defaults block fails its schema.

name: invalid-scope
description: A scope block fails its schema.

name: invalid-when
description: A when block fails its schema.

name: invalid-meta
description: A meta block is not a mapping.

name: missing-id
description: An entry has no id attribute.

name: invalid-id
description: An id does not match the id pattern.

name: unknown-attribute
description: An element carries an attribute it does not define.

name: duplicate-attribute
description: An attribute appears more than once on one element.

name: invalid-attribute-value
description: An attribute value is not allowed for that attribute.

name: disabled-has-value
description: The disabled attribute is given a value.

name: unknown-child
description: An element contains a child it does not allow.

name: duplicate-child
description: An element contains a child that may appear only once.

name: unknown-condition
description: A condition names a key that is not defined.

name: empty-when
description: A when block has no conditions.

name: invalid-glob
description: A glob string is malformed.

name: glob-escapes-base
description: A glob contains a .. segment that escapes its base directory.

name: leading-slash
description: A scope glob starts with a slash.

name: empty-files
description: A scope files list is empty.

name: regex-outside-dialect
description: A regular expression uses syntax outside the allowed dialect.

name: regex-not-one-line
description: A regular expression spans more than one line.

name: inconsistent-indentation
description: A block body mixes indentation inconsistently.

name: unknown-category
description: A category is not built in or declared in config.

name: duplicate-id
description: Two entries resolve to the same id.

name: src-escapes-root
description: A src path resolves outside the repository root.

name: invalid-loreconfig
description: A .loreconfig file fails its schema.

name: repo-inside-repo
description: A .loreconfig repo key appears inside another repository.

name: nested-repo
description: A repository is nested inside another Lore root.

name: missing-category
description: An entry has no category and no default supplies one.

name: empty-scope
description: A scope matches no files.

name: missing-src-target
description: A src attribute points at a file that does not exist.

name: unsupported-check-language
description: A check uses a language the tool does not support.

name: ast-grep-no-language

name: unknown-disabled-id
description: A disable list names an id that does not exist.
